sent:
Lena —

Quick, specific answers.

1) Simple Shopify adds for the £75 nudge
- Free‑shipping progress bar: “Free Shipping Bar” by Hextom is the lightest lift and does the threshold math out of the box.
- Bundles to reach £75: Shopify’s own “Shopify Bundles” handles fixed pairs/trios cleanly (inventory‑aware). Use it for a “Stacks & Gifts” set (e.g., Seafoam + Pebble) and surface it on the ring page and in cart.

2) Track orders per ad→page pair without GA4
- Naming/UTMs: name each ad concept clearly and add UTMs like:
  utm_source=meta | utm_medium=paid-social | utm_campaign=ring-fit-first | utm_content=ring-offer-page-v1
- Shopify capture: orders include the first landing URL; to make it bulletproof, also write UTMs + landing page into cart attributes so they flow into every order:
  a) On page load, read the querystring + pathname.
  b) Populate hidden inputs on the cart form: attributes[utm_campaign], attributes[utm_content], attributes[landing_page].
  c) Shopify carries these attributes onto the order; export Orders CSV and pivot revenue by utm_campaign + utm_content to see the ad→page pairs that produced first orders.
- Creative variants: if multiple creatives hit the same page, add a short creative id in utm_term (e.g., c1, c2) so you can kill losers fast.

3) Ring offer page layout (wireframe)
- Header: minimalist (no mega‑nav); keep the shopper on task.
- Hero (first screen):
  [Product photo]  Recycled silver ring that fits first time
  £XX  |  Size ▼  |  Find your size (popover)  |  ★ 4.8 (180+)
  [Add to bag]
- Trust strip: Free resizing in 30 days • Dispatches in 3–5 days • Recycled silver
- Proof: 2–3 short review quotes with names.
- Details: materials, finish, care, returns (accordion).
- Make it a set (to hit £75): pre‑curated 2‑item stack with 1‑click add‑both; shows “£X to free shipping” progress.
- FAQ: sizing, gift wrap, resizing policy.
- UGC row: 4–6 real photos.
- Sticky Add to Bag + free‑shipping progress as the user scrolls.

Note: If you’re trying to move fast without a dev, Shopify’s new Canvas editor can draft this layout quickly; happy to share the prompt structure that gets the hero + trust + bundle blocks in the right order.

If a 5‑minute teardown video of saltandstrand.example would help, say the word and I’ll record it today; otherwise the wireframe above is the exact stack we’d build first.
